## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is `type(scope): summary`, e.g. `fix(chart): keep labels clear of the NOW badge` (see "PR titles" in CLAUDE.md)
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run size` and `npm run test:e2e` pass
- [ ] Visual change? Screenshots attached (`npm run screenshot`, dark and light)
- [ ] README updated if config options changed
